caption:
Austin-area home sales slowed in September, while the median sale price edged higher.

Unlock MLS’s October 13 report shows these year-over-year changes for the Austin–Round Rock–San Marcos metro:

• 2,223 homes sold — down 14.8%
• $421,000 median sale price — up 1.4%
• 13,465 active listings — down 3.4%
• 5.4 months of inventory — versus 5.5 a year earlier

The broader quarter tells a different price story: July–September sales fell 2.4%, and the quarterly median declined 2.3% to $420,000.

What to take away: September’s higher median does not mean every home gained value, or that prices have broadly turned upward. The median reflects the mix of homes that sold.

Buyers and sellers should compare recent sales for similar properties in their own neighborhood and price range. Metro-wide figures provide context; they do not price an individual home.

Source: Unlock MLS, October 13, 2026
